services.name: Balloon Glows
services.desc: Planning a party, wedding reception, corporate event, festival, school function, or special celebration? A hot air balloon tether is the perfect way to add a memorable “WOW!” factor that your guests will never forget. Grape Escape Balloon Adventures specializes in hot air balloon tether rentals and balloon glows throughout Southern California, with our primary service area focused on the Temecula Valley. We proudly provide tethered hot air balloon experiences for events in Temecula, Murrieta, Wine Country, and surrounding Southern California communities. At this time, we do not travel outside of Southern California for tether or glow events. A tethered hot air balloon is securely anchored

services.name: Private charter flights
services.desc: Take your event, brand, or production to new heights with Grape Escape Balloon Adventures. From hot air balloon advertising that captures attention and creates unforgettable impressions, to hot air balloon charters for film, television, and photography projects, our experienced team helps bring your vision to life above the stunning Temecula Valley. Looking for a unique experience at your next party, wedding, or corporate event? Our tethered hot air balloons hire and evening balloon glows provide a safe, awe-inspiring way to engage guests, showcase your brand, or simply create a “WOW!” moment. With over 34 years of experience, FAA-certified balloons, and expert pilots handling every detail,

blurb: Guests experience a hot air balloon flight over Temecula Valley Wine Country, viewing vineyards, lakes, citrus groves, and estate homes. Flights include a pre-flight briefing, a 60-75 minute flight, and a post-flight celebration with champagne or juice. Private and group flights are available, with certified pilots ensuring safety and comfort.
